investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Kescrest Mutual (insurance); Platform: Microsoft Azure southeastasia (zones southeastasia-1/southeastasia-2/southeastasia-3); network range 10.126.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster kescre-prod-southe (AKS); Database: postgres server payments-db-01 reachable from the application network only through NSG payments-db-01-nsg rule Allow-App-5432; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
